bundle_rule: synthetic evaluation overlay generated from observed activity timestamps; not a humanitarian deployment or original source label
citation: John Burgess, Brian Gallagher, David Jensen, and Brian Neil Levine, MaxProp: Routing for Vehicle-Based Disruption-Tolerant Networking, IEEE INFOCOM, 2006.
conversion_semantics: one undirected contact per pair/timestamp; reciprocal exact-time records deduplicated by maximum observed bytes; fixed registered opportunity window; capacity equals observed bytes subject to a minimum payload rate
excluded_source_fields: GPS coordinates and route labels, per source README
license: CC BY 4.0 (UMass Trace Repository default, accessed 2026-07-18)
role_mapping_rule: rank anonymous bus IDs by total observed contact duration; assign synthetic sites, relays, then clients using deterministic lexical tie-breaking
